\"Nayi booking\" dabayein, customer chun: Press "New booking", pick a customer, add items, enter the pickup date and advance. IMEIs or carpet pieces get reserved.
\"Sale\" dabayein: bill banta hai, stock: Press "Sale": a bill is made, stock leaves this branch, the advance is applied and any rest can go on credit.
\"Tayyar\" par customer ko WhatsApp bhej: When "Ready", send the customer a WhatsApp to collect the goods.

Advance aur baad ki payments kaise aayi: How advance and later payments came in

Booking ke waqt kul ka kitna: Share of total at booking time
Booking ke waqt stock nahi ghatta; sale: Stock goes down at sale, not at booking.
Stock doesn't go down on booking; it leaves this branch at sale
Booking number, customer, phone ya note…: Booking number, customer, phone or note…

Calendar me har din ke pickup aur baqi a: The calendar shows each day's pickups and due amount.
Cancel par advance wapas de sakte hain y: On cancel you can return the advance or keep it in the account. A return may ask for the owner's PIN (Settings).

Carpet ka roll ya cut piece chunein; baq: Pick a carpet roll or cut piece; other goods by name, SKU or barcode
Customer advance de, maal rakha jaye, pi: The customer pays an advance, goods are kept aside, and the bill is made at pickup
Customer aur paise de to \"Payment lein\: When the customer pays more, use "Take payment". Once fully paid, the booking becomes "Ready".

Customer ke khate me jama hota hai; sale: Goes to the customer's account; it is applied to the bill at sale
Goes to the customer's account; it is applied to the bill at sale.
Customer ko slip dein; pasand is device: Give the slip to the customer; your choice is remembered on this device
Customer maal le jaye to \"Sale karein\": When the customer collects, use "Make sale": a bill is made, stock goes out, and the advance is applied to the bill.
Customer ne advance diya ya maal rakhwan: Customer paid an advance or wants goods kept? Make a booking; at pickup the bill is one click.
Discount kul se zyada hai: Discount is more than the total
Fitting, delivery, cutting — kul me jud: Fitting, delivery, cutting: added to the total
Har advance, baad ki payment aur return: Every advance, later payment and return

Har karobari din kitni bookings aayi, au: Bookings each business day, and how they ended
IMEI aur cut piece booking ke liye reser: IMEIs and cut pieces are reserved for the booking; they can't be sold at the counter.

Karigar ki copy me chhupa sakte hain: Can be hidden on the worker's copy

Maal tayyar hai, customer le ja sakta ha: Goods are ready, the customer can collect
Maal tayyar ho jaye to \"Tayyar hai\" da: When the goods are ready, press "Ready" and tell the customer on WhatsApp.
Marzi hai, magar is ke bagair WhatsApp n: Optional, but WhatsApp can't be sent without it.

Type or scan a name, SKU or barcode. The picker opens by itself for type (size/colour), IMEI and carpet roll.

se yahan aayein. Stock booking par nahi: to come here. Stock goes down at sale, not at booking.

Sirf naam zaroori hai; phone ho to Whats: Only the name is needed; with a phone, WhatsApp reminders can go

Upcoming list, calendar aur yaad dihani: The upcoming list, calendar and reminders use this date.
Upcoming tab me late bookings sab se upa: Late bookings are at the top of the Upcoming tab. Take a look every morning.
